name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 250 – Am 35
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 250 a. Urges the Commission to create a compensation fund for individuals who have suffered adverse effects from the COVID-19 vaccination, on the grounds that they have been harmed by the lack of transparency and the refusal to disclose vaccine procurement contracts and related liability arrangements;
